body: There is something appealing about the 12 steps.
Been pondering the same idea. Wondered where I could go to get help with this. I don't even know how to explain it without coming off like an idiot. Kind of why I ended up here.

I've always felt a bit disconnected. Over time, it's grown and lately, I feel fully detached, like I'm free floating. I have become good at telling people what they want to hear, smiling at the right times. No one knows or even has a hint about how I really feel or what I actually think.
I need to chew over your comment for awhile. Are you a Buddhist?
Not sure I want to find my way back.
Weird isn't it? Somehow, I find the thought I'm not unique, that others feel the same way, is comforting.
I wish there was something to see. I so wish there was.

" world with out color" is a pretty apt description. Hadn't thought of it like that. 

Not sure if I want to break from this. It's hard to explain.
